description: What Node's internal live route serves with CONTROL_PLANE_POLICY_STORE=on for KV policy documents of approvals.json (documents), engine-profiles.json (each case's org layer as the org's ceiling) and four model-access documents, after the policy-layers migration copied them: the deployment's sections of the approvals document and the org's stored layers, re-scoped to live. `migration` is the org's status in the migration's report; `invalid` documents are never copied, so `live` is null and no reader can be served them from the store. Written by backend/nodejs/apps/tests/modules/agent-harness/cpd10-store-on-live-layers.test.ts (UPDATE_GOLDENS=1); read by backend/python/tests/unit/harness/policy/test_cpd10_store_on_readers.py, which holds each reader's answer from `live` equal to its answer from `documents`.
